pages.text: Put your whole storage room in one grid. Refined Storage is the T3 digital storage and autocrafting system.

$(bold)Dual-path recipes:$() IridescentCraft adds a dual-path recipe system for RS components. The tech path uses Mekanism/Thermal materials and the magic path uses Botania/Ars Nouveau materials; the hybrid path (both) gives double yield.$(br2)$(bold)T4 upgrade:$() Advanced RS components (Disk Drives, Pattern Encoders for complex autocrafting) are T4 content. Basic storage is T3.
$(bold)Setup recommendation:$() Build RS alongside your Mekanism ore processing chain. Autocrafting speeds up T3 progression a great deal.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Refined Storage is documented at $(bold)refinedmods.com/refined-storage$(), and in game JEI has every crafting recipe. Once the Controller and Disk Drive are placed, the system is mostly easy to figure out.
